video_cube_orbit — VIDEOCUBE render op

• 資料種類:video → rgbvideo

• 呼叫: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.video_cube_orbit(video, n_frames: 'int' = 36, pitch: 'float' = 25.0, yaw_start: 'float' = 0.0, yaw_span: 'float' = 360.0, size: 'int' = 256, sigma: 'float' = 1.0, alpha_gain: 'float' = 1.0, static_alpha: 'float' = 0.02, color: 'str' = 'time', mode: 'str' = 'motion', depth_samples: 'int | None' = None, floor: 'float' = 0.15) -> 'np.ndarray'(要直接呼叫實作,import videocube; videocube.video_cube_orbit(video, n_frames: 'int' = 36, pitch: 'float' = 25.0, yaw_start: 'float' = 0.0, yaw_span: 'float' = 360.0, size: 'int' = 256, sigma: 'float' = 1.0, alpha_gain: 'float' = 1.0, static_alpha: 'float' = 0.02, color: 'str' = 'time', mode: 'str' = 'motion', depth_samples: 'int | None' = None, floor: 'float' = 0.15) -> 'np.ndarray';從台帳取用則 opsvideocube.get("video_cube_orbit"))

用法

旋轉立方體的彩色影片 (n_frames, size, size, 3) float [0, 1] (rgbvideo)。

把 video_spacetime_cube(mode) 作為不透明度("motion" = 影片的軌跡,"dark" / "bright" = z 堆疊中的膜或細胞),color="time" 時依首軸(時刻 / 深度)上色,"intensity" 時依亮度上色,yaw 從 yaw_start 起在 yaw_span 度範圍內等分旋轉(pitch 固定)。展示與 Studio 的出口。可用 video_write_gif 直接做成 GIF。

>>> frames = video_cube_orbit(clip, n_frames=24, size=200)

>>> video_write_gif(frames, "cube.gif", fps=10)
